Definition: a Tsorite or Tsorathite, i.e. inhabitants of Tsorah
BiblicalUsage: A Zorite is an inhabitant of Zorah, the town in Judah where Samson was born. In 1 Chronicles 2:53, the families of Kirjath-jearim.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that the Zorite is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
